title: Essentials + Bodybuilding Transformation
author: George Grafton
desc:
Warmup : 
1. Low Intensity Cardio : Pick any machine which elevates. your heart rate to 100-135 BPM
2. Front/Back Leg Swing (leg days only) : 12 each leg
3. Side/Side Leg Swing (leg days only) : 12 each leg
4. Arm Swings : 12 (Swing your arms out to the sides)
5. Cable Leg External Rotation : 15 each leg

ex.note:
WU 2-3. Rest ~3min. Backoff set.
Focus on strength here. Each week add weight or reps. Keep form consistent.

WU 2. Rest ~2min.
Do first set wide overhand (1.5x shoulder width), second set underhand (1x shoulder width).

WU 1. Rest ~2min.
Bring the dumbbells all the way down, keep your torso upright.

WU 1. Rest ~2min. Dropset.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together, drive your elbows down and back. Last set only do a dropset: perform 10-12 reps, drop by ~50%, perform addit. 10-12.

ss.note:
WU 1. Rest 0. With EZ bar.
Arc the bar behind your head, constant tension on triceps

WU 1. Rest ~1.5min
Arc the bar "out" not "up", focus on squeezing your biceps.

ex.note:
WU 2-3. Rest ~3min. Backoff set.
Focus on strength here. Each week add weight or reps. Keep form consistent.

WU 1. Rest ~1.5min. Dropset
perform 10-12 reps, drop the weight by ~50%,perform an additional 10-12 reps.

ss.note:
WU 1. Rest 0.
Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

WU 1. Rest ~1.5min.
Knees to chest, controlled reps, straighten legs more to increase difficulty.

ex.note:
WU 2. Rest ~2min
Add defecit by standing on bumper plate. Get a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest every rep.

WU 2. Rest ~2min.
Dont stop between reps, keep a smooth and controlled tension

WU 1. Rest ~2min.
Pull elbows down and in, minimize swinging.

WU 2. Rest ~2min. Dropset.
Do a mix of incline and neutral. Can be performed seated or standing. Focus on squeezing your chest.

ss.note:
WU 1. Rest 0.
Keep elbow behind torso, one arm at a time, focus on bicep squeeze

WU 1. Rest ~1.5min
Focus on squeezing your triceps to move the weight.

ex.note:

Cable at hip height, brace on bar, pinky up

WU 2. Rest ~2min.
Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round

WU 2. Rest ~2 min.
Medium width feet placement on the platform, don't allow your lower back to round. Knees should go over toes.

WU 1. Rest ~2min. Dropset
Seat as far back as it will go. Pull on handles to keep butt in seat.
